falsification_conditions.condition: The blowoff score increases to 85 or higher within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A blowoff score exceeding 85 would indicate extreme market momentum, invalidating the 'UNKNOWN' verdict by confirming a clear trend phase (e.g., blowoff top/bottom).

falsification_conditions.condition: The ETF's price closes below the 200-day moving average by 5% or more
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would break the pattern similarity to top_2024_mar_etf (which likely reflects a bullish trend), invalidating the 'HOLD' signal by confirming a bearish reversal.

falsification_conditions.condition: Volume spikes to 200% above the 30-day average on a single day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such a spike would indicate a clear market event (e.g., panic selling or buying), falsifying the 'UNKNOWN' phase by confirming a definitive market direction.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
